meta.notes: First scan. Danish is the biggest filter: many Copenhagen roles in your field are posted in Danish or require it, so remote and English-first employers are your best lane. Manager titles are where the 40,000 kroner sits.

health.notes: Mostly student and volunteer roles this week

dream.name: Mesh Community
dream.roles: Event Coordinator (temporary, Danish required). Already applied.

dream.name: Hobo Copenhagen
dream.roles: House Creator closed 2 Aug, Danish required. Hotel opens Q1 2027: worth a direct note to the General Manager.

jobs.title: Events & Partnerships Coordinator
jobs.notes: Almost word for word your profile: brand events, pop-ups and partner activations, applications in English only. Lead with Nordic Fintech Week (20+ community partners, 33 volunteers, suppliers). Retail rather than impact. 100+ clicks already, apply this week.

jobs.title: Senior Events Growth Manager
jobs.notes: An events and community company, which they ask for directly. Your 50+ events and Luma-style event marketing fit. Gap: senior title and they want audience growth with HubSpot, so put attendance and partner numbers up front. Best route to your salary target.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Science Hub Denmark
jobs.notes: Ecosystem and hub work, close to Copenhagen Fintech and Health Tech Hub. Honest gaps: they ask for a science master's or PhD and presenting in Danish. Frame your hub experience as the reason to stretch.

jobs.title: Communications & Business Development Associate
jobs.notes: Climate, two organisations, lots of stakeholder work. DKK 36,000 to 38,000 plus 6% pension. They want a start between now and 1 December, so say January clearly if you apply.

jobs.title: Program Manager, GAME Creators (fixed term)
jobs.notes: Runs creator and community programmes day to day. Gap: they want gaming or creator-platform experience. Your community-building and partner programmes are the angle.

jobs.title: Events Manager - Remote
jobs.notes: Fully remote, real events ownership, EUR 55,000 to 70,000. Gap: they want experience running events for developer or data audiences, and 100+ have applied.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.notes: Design brand, creative side. 1 to 3 years asked, Danish or German a plus only. Likely below your salary target.

jobs.title: Field & Community Marketing Manager
jobs.notes: Meetups, conferences and webinars, 100% remote. Database software, so no impact angle, and they want B2B tech marketing.
